critical_code_review_comments: auth.ts bootstrapAuth: try/finally + 6s safety setTimeout is correct — it clears the timer on success and only forces loading=false if state.loading is still true. Handles storage/native throws via outer try/catch. Good.

app/index.tsx splash: removed `if (loading) return` guard is the actual bug fix — the 1.4s navigation setTimeout is now unconditional. The dependency array still includes `loading` so if auth resolves before 1.4s, the effect re-runs and re-schedules with correct target route; if auth resolves after navigation, the current screen (e.g. /onboarding or /role-select) is unaffected. Verified working for both no-token and valid-token paths.
User type in auth.ts now includes 'admin' — good, prevents TS narrowing issues in splash router.replace('/admin') branch.

storage util (SecureStore on native / localStorage on web) is awaited inside bootstrapAuth — worst-case a stuck native SecureStore call is now capped at 6s and users see role-select/onboarding instead of an infinite splash. Solid defensive fix.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (already fixed): bootstrapAuth() in /app/frontend/src/auth.ts could silently fail or hang on native SecureStore/AsyncStorage, leaving state.loading=true forever. /app/frontend/app/index.tsx splash previously had `if (loading) return` before scheduling its 1.4s navigation setTimeout, so the timer was NEVER SCHEDULED and the splash was stuck permanently. FIX (verified this iteration): (a) bootstrapAuth wraps body in try/finally and starts a 6s hard safety setTimeout that force-sets loading=false if it hasn't already; (b) splash unconditionally schedules the 1.4s navigation setTimeout on mount regardless of loading state — the effect re-runs when auth resolves so the target route is always correct; (c) User type in auth.ts includes 'admin'. REPRO WORKED PRE-FIX only on native / when storage was slow. POST-FIX: verified splash→onboarding at 1.4s with cleared storage, and splash→/admin at 1.4s with token.
